translated_title: Former President Vicente Fox and Ex-PAN Governors Defend Ruffo Appel and Allege ‘Political Persecution’
original_title: Vicente Fox y ex gobernadores panistas defienden a Ruffo Appel y acusan "persecución política"
author: Juan Carlos G. Partida
meta_description: Mexico’s PAN old guard closes ranks, recasting a fuel-smuggling and organized-crime suspect as a persecuted ‘political prisoner.’
